risks.risk: The toner cartridges may be empty or the drum may be near the end of its life.
risks.proof: A photo of the system status screen showing the remaining toner levels.

Photo of the machine unplugged with the plastic wrap removed.
Photo of the system status screen showing toner and drum levels.
